title: Compatibility contracts & migration guidelines for tokens, components, and charts
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Create a compact, operational governance artifact that defines compatibility contracts for design tokens, component APIs (buttons, tables), and chart primitives, plus an associated migration and deprecation workflow. This ticket covers: a) semantic token versioning and delta-testing requirements so themes and runtime mapping remain stable across releases; b) a component compatibility contract (public surface, prop stability, stable CSS/DOM hooks) with mandatory checks; c) chart primitives compatibility (data-shape expectations, responsive breakpoints, performance budgets); d) a formal RFC template and lifecycle for any breaking change; e) a standardized deprecation cadence, migration guide template, and automation hooks (codemods, docs redirects). The goal is a single place design teams and engineers can reference to evaluate risk, surface impact, and run migrations with minimal product disruption.
acceptance_criteria: A short Compatibility Contract document exists and is approved by Design, Platform, and Eng leads
An RFC template for compatibility-impacting changes is published with reviewer roles and SLA for feedback (5 business days)
A review checklist (tokens, components, charts) is added to the DS PR template and validated on two pilot PRs
Deprecation policy is documented with minimum windows (notice, soft-deprecation, removal) and migration templates for each component family
Automation guidance included: recommended codemod patterns, a changelog format, and a scriptable test that checks token diffs and visual regressions
checklist: Define semantic token versioning scheme (major.minor.patch) and mapping rules for legacy tokens
Create delta-test expectations for token changes (visual snapshots + cross-theme assertions)
Specify component public surface contract: exported props, behaviour invariants, CSS/DOM contract, and allowed internal refactors
Chart contract: data schema examples, axis/tooltip contracts, and performance budget per render (ms)
Draft RFC template that captures: motivation, backwards-compatibility matrix, migration plan, rollout window
Design PR template augment: attach impact score, list affected products, mark required engineers and product reviewers
Deprecation timeline: 90-day notice -> 180-day soft-deprecation with opt-out flags -> 365-day removal (default, adjustable by impact)
Provide migration guide archetypes: tokens-only, component-prop rename, chart-data-shape changes
Identify two pilot migrations (primary button prop rename; chart data-field rename) and build codemod examples
Publish checklist and RFC doc to Confluence and add link to DS README + Console release notes flow
